response.justification: The candidate lacks critical required qualifications including C programming for UNIX embedded systems, Linux kernel modification experience, Japanese language proficiency, and any demonstrated background in network security protocols (MACsec, 802.1X), switch firmware, or embedded device control — all central to the role.
strengths: Strong full-stack engineering experience across multiple languages and platforms
Demonstrated open-source contributions and technical teaching ability
Experience with Linux, Docker, and low-latency systems
concerns: No evidence of C programming in embedded or UNIX firmware contexts
No Japanese language proficiency — a mandatory requirement
No exposure to LAN-switch security technologies, networking protocols, or embedded chip SDKs
